periods.summary: After Stella joins Alice in the Luxel city fight, Or-Gaule is driven into a losing two-on-one battle. He explains to Stella that Lunaeyes won the representative-war format by promising to personally execute her family if Vermillion lost, delighting in the thought of her anguish. Stella and Alice attack together, using dragon flame, flight and the Black Knight's axe to force him through repeated evasions. He blocks with Spider Nest, repairs injuries with thread, escapes downward through a cut-open street into the sewer and back out, but his stamina and options collapse. At the decisive moment he begs Alice as her younger brother. The childhood memory and her hidden wish to protect him surface; she strikes Stella instead, shields him, and tells him to run. Or-Gaule instantly accepts the lifeline, thanks and professes love to Alice, then escapes into the sky while she turns her weapon on Stella and then Ikki.

key_events.summary: Reveals that Lunaeyes bought the representative war by wagering that she would execute her own family if Vermillion lost.
Begging Alice as his sister causes her to defend him, enabling his escape.
